name: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd
title: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd - 543384 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Nykaa Q4 FY26 shows GMV and revenue growth of 28% with EBITDA margin 8.4% and fashion breakeven; capex is light at about 1% of revenue, but no capacity or supply-side metrics were disclosed.

capex.quote: our capex utilization here, as we can see, has become more efficient, and it currently stands at about 1% of revenue

triggers.label: Working capital days 34 → 28
triggers.quote: Working capital days, as you can see, has improved further from an already healthy 34 days to even better at 28 days now

triggers.label: Fashion NSV growth 42% in Q4
triggers.quote: particularly on NSV it was 42% year-on-year growth

triggers.label: April-May growth momentum good
triggers.quote: April and May have been good overall for the business in terms of the growth momentum

guidance.value: about 50-60 doors a year; ~170-180 more over 2-3 years
guidance.quote: you can say about 170 or 180 doors more over the next 2 to 3 years, averages out to about 50- 60 doors a year

guidance.value: each business to keep improving margin profile; similar trajectory in coming years
guidance.quote: you could assume that all else remaining constant, you can see similar trajectory in the coming years

red_flags.label: Fashion EBITDA still negative for FY26 (-2.6%)
red_flags.quote: A significant improvement in EBITDA margin from minus 8.3% in FY '25 to minus 2.6%

red_flags.label: AOV growth muted; growth reliant on customer acquisition
red_flags.quote: we have not seen too much growth in AOV in the past several quarters

evasions.topic: Own-brand share of platform / margin steady state
evasions.quote: So I don't know if we've given the exact numbers in terms of guidance.

evasions.topic: Nykaa Now salience and FY27 growth outlook
evasions.quote: I don't think it's disclosed but we can get back to you offline
